title: AudioLab Recipe v1 native audio lifecycle
description: Runs a native audio extraction probe through the existing app bridge, polls the async result, and records UI evidence.

proofTargets.claim: Recipe v1 can drive AudioLab native-module probes through a namespaced action.
The runner emits summary, trace, artifact manifest, and screenshot evidence.

status.intent: Read the current AudioLab recorder state through the project bridge.

record.intent: Open the recorder for audio validation.

extractPreview.intent: Run the native extractPreview probe and wait for its bridged success result.

proof.intent: Preserve the visible audio tools as navigation proof.
